label: NODE-1
title: NODE-1 — implement score tier with Node TDD
description: Disposable Node fixture only. Add tierForScore(points) to node_fixture/score.js and export it. Return bronze for finite scores from 0 through 49, silver from 50 through 99, and gold for 100 or more. Reject negative, NaN and infinite inputs with RangeError. Create node_fixture/tests/tier.test.js before editing code; run Red, then Green, then the complete suite. Cover thresholds 0, 49, 50, 99, 100 and invalid inputs. Preserve all existing tests and protected Python/Node files byte-for-byte. Use exactly: cd /workspace && node --test 2>&1. Do not use GitHub, Docker, network, credentials or other projects.
review_instruction: Review frozen /delivery only, without edits. Require Node tests for 0, 49, 50, 99, 100, negative, NaN and infinity; confirm score.test.js and all old Python tests remain unchanged. Use the controlled complete-suite validation, not a Red replay. If evidence is missing, request changes from the original implementer. End with one standalone line Decision: APPROVE or Decision: REQUEST_CHANGES;Reason: <specific finding>, then concise evidence. No GitHub, Docker, network, credentials or other projects.
